column_integrals.iwp_optical: sum((DEN*DELZ)*(QI+QS)) in kg m-2, matching the QI+QS ice optical mapping
limitations: No column-area or domain-total water budget is claimed.
These are offline KDM state diagnostics, not forecast or host-cycle validation.
No synthetic number floors or external data are used.
column_integrals.lwp_QC: sum((DEN*DELZ)*QC) in kg m-2; QC retained as kg kg-1 dry-air layer mixing ratio
column_integrals.qg_optional: sum((DEN*DELZ)*QG) in kg m-2, reported separately; not folded into optical IWP

density_and_layer_thickness.DELZ: same-call thickness in meters, bitwise fixed between baseline and candidate
density_and_layer_thickness.baseline_DEN: offline replay of the exact NativeBatchMicrophysics._prep_batch using saved baseline T/Q and fixed native geometry; DEN*DELZ bitwise checked against APPLIED_PHYSICS_AUDIT weights
density_and_layer_thickness.candidate_DEN_DELZ: direct saved same-call applied_forcing rows 0 and 3, bitwise checked against source prep replay
density_and_layer_thickness.rho_postEOS: saved rho_d preserved separately and bitwise checked against same-call DEN

temperature_provenance.expression_order: pii=(P_center_Pa/p0).pow(kappa); theta_dry=(THM_after+T0)/(1+alpha*QV_after); T_native=theta_dry*pii; RTTOV reverses the 39 native levels, then prepends fixed upper-reference levels.
temperature_provenance.physical_export_order: native bottom-first; stored RTTOV native segment is top-first
temperature_provenance.stored_profile_verification: for every profile_valid row, native_to_rttov_profile T[-39:] is compared bitwise to stored profile_T[-39:]
